extension.summary: Everyone in the household keeps their own watch history, through your own CrossWatch.
extension.description: CrossWatch (crosswatch.app) is a free, self-hosted app that keeps watch history, ratings and playback progress in sync between media servers such as Plex, Jellyfin and Emby and trackers such as Trakt and Simkl, with a profile per person. This add-on needs a running CrossWatch on your network.[CR][CR]It reports what plays in Kodi, and who is watching, so each person's history reaches their own accounts. The viewer is worked out from smart playlist membership, the active Kodi profile, or a question when playback stops, remembered per show. Optionally, rate an episode or film after watching it.[CR][CR]Optionally, library sync keeps Kodi's watched state, ratings and resume points in step with each person's accounts, both ways (needs CrossWatch 0.15.0 or newer).[CR][CR]Maintained by Rouzax, not by the CrossWatch project: report add-on problems on GitHub (github.com/crosswatch-app/kodi-addon).
extension.news:
v1.1.4 (2026-11-27) - Ratings on items PlexKodiConnect or Jellyfin for Kodi just added are left to that add-on.
v1.1.3 (2026-11-27) - Now works on Kodi 21 for Windows and Xbox. - Library sync no longer keeps re-checking ratings after the library changed during a read. - Items from PlexKodiConnect and Jellyfin for Kodi are always left out of library sync.
v1.1.2 (2026-11-26) - Library sync no longer gets stuck when a large new show is marked watched right after a library scan. - Marks made in Kodi are no longer lost when the add-on's mark list is busy. - Kodi closes faster when CrossWatch can't be reached.
v1.1.1 (2026-11-26) - Now also runs on a Kodi built with Python 3.10. - Library sync no longer risks an error reading Kodi's dates after it has run once.
v1.1.0 (2026-11-26) - New: library sync. What each person's services know (watched, ratings, where they stopped) shows up in Kodi, and what you mark or rate in Kodi reaches that person's services. - Turn it on with Set up library sync in the add-on settings; a status screen shows how it is going. - Items several people own sync for each of them; the status screen asks whose a change made in Kodi was. - Nothing is removed from Kodi or your services unless you turn on "Send removals made in Kodi". - Library sync needs CrossWatch 0.15.0 or newer. Playback reporting works as before without it.
